propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map silently recover only the first 50 issues due to unpaginated search_issues calls with default max_results=50, omitting all issues beyond that threshold
search_issues does not page through results; callers that assume full project recovery without pagination lose issues when project size exceeds 50
the root cause is default max_results=50 in search_issues; Jira DC silently caps pages below the configured instance limit, so short pages are not proof of exhaustion
a shared _paged_search helper must be extracted to eliminate duplicate hand-rolled paging logic across three callers (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map, get_parent_map) and prevent future instances
the pager must advance by len(batch) and terminate only on an empty page, not on short pages, to correctly handle Jira DC's silent truncation behavior
get_parent_map already implements the correct paging logic but must be refactored to use the shared helper to maintain consistency and prevent code drift
